platform_mcp_contrado_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CONTRADO_API_KEY
platform_mcp_contrado_api_key.description: Contrado Helix private token (Contrado Store Account > API Integration; shown once at creation), sent as `X-API-Key`. Scopes: StoresRead, StoreProductsRead, StoreOrdersRead.

platform_mcp_contrado_store_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CONTRADO_STORE_ID
platform_mcp_contrado_store_id.description: Store id sent as `X-Store-Id`; needed only with an account-level token (a store-level token already names its store).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /helix/v1/stores returns the envelope {success, message, data: {storeId, storeName, storeURL, cultureCode, ...}} for the stores the token can access (scope StoresRead). Rate limit 100 requests/minute.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /helix/v1/stores/products (scope StoreProductsRead): the store's designed products [{storeProductId, baseProductId, storeProductName, storeProductDescription, productThumb, productImages, storeProductURL, collectionId, isOutOfStock}] inside the {success, data} envelope; `query` and `category` are not accepted (products of one collection come from /stores/collections/{collectionId}/products, not mapped). Prices come from /stores/products/{id}/option-variants (not mapped).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /helix/v1/stores/products/{storeProductId}: data {storeProductId, storeProductName, productThumb, productImages, product3dImages, productSpecification, sizeChart, productionTime, shippingPriceGroupId, isOutOfStock}.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /helix/v1/orders/{orderId} (scope StoreOrdersRead; orderId is Contrado's integer order id): data {orderId, orderStatus, referenceId, externalReferenceId, orderedUtcDateTime, orderTrackingStatus, trackingId, trackingUrl, totalPrice, currencyCode, deliveryAddress, orderLineItems, orderSummary}.
